Bill.BriefDescription: Repealing the requirement for a study and report concerning direct practices that the office of the insurance commissioner must provide to the legislature.

BillSection.RCWSLText: RCW 48.150.120 (Commissioner's studyReportto legislature) and 2007 c 267 s 14 are each repealed.
